s: I am Maya, and I am in my kitchen today.
And my friend Lena is here with me.
Your kitchen smells so good, Maya.
I have a big pot on the stove.
The pot is full of hot water.
A big pot is best for soup.
Is the soup for many people?
But I love a big pot.
In a big pot, I can put a lot of vegetables.
What vegetables do you put in the pot?
I cut three carrots and put them in the pot.
Carrots are sweet, and carrots make the soup sweet.
What else goes in the pot?
I cut two potatoes into small pieces.
The potatoes go into the pot with the carrots.
Potatoes are soft and good in soup.
Fried potatoes are the best, but potatoes in soup are wonderful.
I cut one tomato into the pot.
A tomato makes the soup red and fresh.
One tomato is enough for this pot.
Do you put salt in the soup, Maya?
The soup needs a little salt.
Too much salt is not good.
Do you use a pan too?
I see a pan on the stove.
Yes, this pan is for the onions.
I put a little oil in the pan.
Now the onions go into the pan.
They fry in the hot pan.
A hot pan and a little oil.
The pot has the soup, and the pan has the onions.
The pot and the pan are both busy today!
Yes, the pot and the pan are my best friends in the kitchen.
The pot is for soup, and the pan is for frying.
Now, let me pour the soup into a bowl.
A bowl is perfect for hot soup.
I like to eat soup from a bowl.
Here, Lena, this bowl is for you.
And this bowl is for me.
The soup in this bowl smells amazing.
The bowl is hot, so I will be careful.
I have something sweet for after dinner.
Do you make the cake with sugar?
Yes, with a lot of sugar.
I put two cups of sugar in the cake.
I melt the butter in a pan.
Look, the butter is soft now.
Soft butter is best for cake.
Then I mix the sugar and the butter together.
The sugar and the butter make the cake sweet and soft.
First, a hot bowl of soup.
Then cake with sugar and butter.
A pot, a pan, a bowl, salt, sugar, butter, oil, carrots, potatoes, and a tomato.
Ten wonderful words, and one wonderful dinner.
Come to my kitchen any time, Lena.
Thank you for cooking with us today.
